PROJECT CONTEXT

Industrial expertise, made easier to explore.

Dynalektric is an industrial electrical manufacturer. Its website brings engineering capabilities, products and applications into one digital experience, with a route from exploration to enquiry.

01 / The challenge

Give technical expertise a clear customer journey.

Industrial information needs a useful structure. The design challenge was to help visitors understand the company, find relevant capabilities and move into a product or application conversation without losing context.

02 / What InnooRyze did

Connect strategy with the experience people use.

Website strategy, information architecture, user experience, interface design and development were brought together. The work connects the company story with manufacturing capabilities, product discovery and the enquiry journey.

03 / What was built

A responsive digital foundation.

A company website that presents engineering and manufacturing information across screen sizes. Product and application content give visitors more ways to explore, while enquiry routes connect that interest to a business conversation.
